What do you mean by total hip arthroplasty (THA)? Hip replacement is a surgical technique in which a prosthetic implant, or hip prosthesis, is used to replace the hip joint. An entire hip replacement or a partial hip replacement can be performed during hip replacement surgery. Orthopaedic joint replacement procedures are typically performed to treat hip fractures or the pain associated with arthritis. snippet_highlighted_words: protect the eye and prevent further injury

list.title: 1. Immobilize the patient:
list.snippet: Keep the patient still, preferably lying down with their head and shoulders slightly elevated. Avoid moving the patient unless absolutely necessary, and do not move their neck.

list.title: 2. Protect the eye:
list.snippet: Do not touch, rub, or apply pressure to the injured eye or any embedded object. If a foreign object is present, gently place pads around it and bandage it in place without applying any pressure.

list.title: 3. Prevent further injury:
list.snippet: Avoid any attempts to remove the object or manipulate the eye.

list.title: 4. Seek immediate medical attention:
list.snippet: Call emergency services (e.g., 911) for prompt transport to a medical facility.
